versos.hebraico: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

controles.web: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
controles.kjv: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
controles.livre: Escutai, céus, e falarei; E ouça a terra os ditos de minha boca.

versos.hebraico: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּמָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּטַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּשְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי־דֶ֔שֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־עֵֽשֶׂב׃

controles.web: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
controles.kjv: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
controles.livre: Gotejará como a chuva minha doutrina; Destilará como o orvalho meu discurso; Como o chuvisco sobre a grama, E como as gotas sobre a erva:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
controles.kjv: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
controles.livre: Porque invocarei o nome do SENHOR; Engrandecei ao nosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: הַצּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔וֹ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּרָכָ֖יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְיָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא׃

controles.web: The Rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
controles.kjv: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
controles.livre: Ele é a Rocha, sua obra é perfeita, pois todos os seus caminhos são justos. Deus fiel, e sem imoralidade; justo e correto ele é.

versos.hebraico: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣יו מוּמָ֑ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל׃

controles.web: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
controles.kjv: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
controles.livre: Corromperam-se contra ele; não são seus filhos, a falha é deles./fn/keyCorromperam-se ... é deles/*keyobscuro/*fn São uma geração perversa e distorcida.

versos.hebraico: הֲ־לַיְהוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ־זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְלֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲלוֹא־הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
controles.kjv: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
controles.livre: É assim que pagais ao SENHOR, ó povo tolo e insensato? Não é ele teu pai que te adquiriu, te fez, e te estabeleceu?

versos.hebraico: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דּוֹר־וָד֑וֹר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֨יךָ֙ וְיַגֵּ֔דְךָ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְיֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
controles.kjv: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
controles.livre: Lembra-te dos tempos antigos; Considerai os anos de geração e geração: Pergunta a teu pai, que ele te declarará; A teus anciãos, e eles te dirão.

versos.hebraico: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Quando o Altíssimo fez herdar às nações, Quando fez dividir os filhos dos homens, Estabeleceu os termos dos povos Segundo o número dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
controles.kjv: For the Lord’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
controles.livre: Porque a parte do SENHOR é seu povo; Jacó a medida de sua herança.

versos.hebraico: יִמְצָאֵ֨הוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֨נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖נְהוּ כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
controles.kjv: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
controles.livre: Achou-o em terra de deserto, E em deserto horrível e ermo; Cercou-o, instruiu-o, Guardou-o como a menina de seu olho.

versos.hebraico: כְּנֶ֨שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל־גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖הוּ עַל־אֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
controles.kjv: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
controles.livre: Como a água desperta sua ninhada, paira sobre seus passarinhos, Estende suas asas, os toma, os leva sobre suas penas:

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑נּוּ וְאֵ֥ין עִמּ֖וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
controles.kjv: So the Lord alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
controles.livre: O SENHOR sozinho o guiou, e nenhum deus estrangeiro esteve com ele.

versos.hebraico: יַרְכִּבֵ֨הוּ֙ עַל־במותי אָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַיֵּנִקֵ֤הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע וְשֶׁ֖מֶן מֵחַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר׃

controles.web: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
controles.kjv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
controles.livre: Ele o fez cavalgar sobre as alturas da terra; comeu os frutos do campo, e o fez que chupar mel da rocha, e azeite da dura pederneira;

versos.hebraico: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַחֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם־חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְאֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־בָשָׁן֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם־חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְדַם־עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה־חָֽמֶר׃

controles.web: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
controles.kjv: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
controles.livre: Manteiga de vacas e leite de ovelhas, Com gordura de cordeiros, E carneiros de Basã; também machos de bode, Com o melhor do trigo: E sangue de uva bebeste, vinho puro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַיִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וַיְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
controles.kjv: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
controles.livre: E engordou Jesurum, e deu coices: Engordaste-te, engrossaste-te, cobriste-te: E deixou ao Deus que lhe fez, E menosprezou a Rocha de sua salvação.

versos.hebraico: יַקְנִאֻ֖הוּ בְּזָרִ֑ים בְּתוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
controles.kjv: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
controles.livre: Provocaram-lhe ciúmes com os deuses alheios; irritaram-lhe com abominações.

versos.hebraico: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַשֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִקָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
controles.kjv: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
controles.livre: Sacrificaram aos demônios, não a Deus; a deuses que não conheciam, a novos deuses vindos de perto, Que não haviam temido vossos pais.

versos.hebraico: צ֥וּר יְלָדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
controles.kjv: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
controles.livre: Abandonaste a Rocha que te gerou; e te esqueceste do Deus que te criou.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּנְאָ֑ץ מִכַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖יו וּבְנֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
controles.kjv: And when the Lord saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR o viu, e acendeu-se em ira, pelo menosprezo de seus filhos e de suas filhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא־אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽם׃

controles.web: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
controles.kjv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
controles.livre: E disse: esconderei deles meu rosto, verei qual será seu fim; pois são geração de perversidades, filhos sem fidelidade.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּנִי בְלֹא־אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣ם בְּלֹא־עָ֔ם בְּג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽם׃

controles.web: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
controles.kjv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
controles.livre: Eles me provocaram ciúmes com o que não é Deus; com suas vaidades provocaram-me à ira; eu também provocarei os ciúmes com aqueles que não são povo, e com uma nação insensata eu os provocarei à ira.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּיקַ֖ד עַד־שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ וִֽיבֻלָ֔הּ וַתְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים׃

controles.web: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
controles.kjv: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
controles.livre: Porque um fogo se acendeu em meu furor, e arderá até as profundezas do mundo dos mortos; e consumirá a terra e seus frutos, e abrasará os fundamentos dos montes.

versos.hebraico: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה־בָּֽם׃

controles.web: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
controles.kjv: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
controles.livre: Eu trarei males sobre eles; Gastarei neles minhas flechas.

versos.hebraico: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּלְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְקֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְשֶׁן־בְּהֵמוֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח־בָּ֔ם עִם־חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר׃

controles.web: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
controles.kjv: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
controles.livre: Consumidos serão de fome, e comidos de febre ardente E de amarga pestilência; Dente de animais enviarei também sobre eles, Com veneno de serpente da terra.

versos.hebraico: מִחוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל־חֶ֔רֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם־בָּחוּר֙ גַּם־בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם־אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה׃

controles.web: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror; on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
controles.kjv: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
controles.livre: De fora desolará a espada, E dentro das câmaras o espanto: Tanto ao rapaz como à virgem, Ao que mama como o homem grisalho.

versos.hebraico: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵאֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽם׃

controles.web: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
controles.kjv: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
controles.livre: Disse: Eu os dispersaria do mundo, Faria cessar dentre os homens a memória deles,

versos.hebraico: לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן־יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑ימוֹ פֶּן־יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣ינוּ רָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כָּל־זֹֽאת׃

controles.web: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted, Yahweh has not done all this.’”
controles.kjv: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.
controles.livre: Se não temesse a ira do inimigo, Não seja que se envaideçam seus adversários, Não seja que digam: Nossa mão alta fez tudo isto, não o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה׃

controles.web: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
controles.kjv: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
controles.livre: Porque são gente de perdidos conselhos, E não há neles entendimento.

versos.hebraico: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃

controles.web: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
controles.kjv: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
controles.livre: Bom seria se fossem sábios, que compreendessem isto, E entendessem seu fim!

versos.hebraico: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם־לֹא֙ כִּי־צוּרָ֣ם מְכָרָ֔ם וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽם׃

controles.web: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
controles.kjv: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?
controles.livre: Como poderia perseguir um a mil, E dois fariam fugir a dez mil, Se sua Rocha não os houvesse vendido, E o SENHOR não os houvesse entregue?

versos.hebraico: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְצוּרֵ֖נוּ צוּרָ֑ם וְאֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ פְּלִילִֽים׃

controles.web: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
controles.kjv: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
controles.livre: Que a rocha deles não é como nossa Rocha: E nossos inimigos sejam disso juízes.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־מִגֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔ם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֨מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי־ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
controles.kjv: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
controles.livre: Porque da vide de Sodoma é a vide deles, E dos sarmentos de Gomorra: As uvas deles são uvas venenosas, cachos muito amargos têm.

versos.hebraico: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑ם וְרֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר׃

controles.web: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
controles.kjv: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
controles.livre: Veneno de serpentes é seu vinho, e peçonha cruel de áspides.

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹא־ה֖וּא כָּמֻ֣ס עִמָּדִ֑י חָתֻ֖ם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
controles.kjv: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
controles.livre: Não tenho eu isto guardado, Selado em meus tesouros?

versos.hebraico: לִ֤י נָקָם֙ וְשִׁלֵּ֔ם לְעֵ֖ת תָּמ֣וּט רַגְלָ֑ם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם וְחָ֖שׁ עֲתִדֹ֥ת לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
controles.kjv: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
controles.livre: Minha é a vingança e o pagamento, Ao tempo que seu pé vacilará; Porque o dia de sua aflição está próximo, E o que lhes está preparado se apressa.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יָדִ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָ֖יו יִתְנֶחָ֑ם כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּי־אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְאֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְעָזֽוּב׃

controles.web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
controles.kjv: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR julgará a seu povo, E por causa de seus servos se arrependerá, Quando vir que a força pereceu, E que não há prisioneiro nem livre.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַ֖ר אֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ימוֹ צ֖וּר חָסָ֥יוּ בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge;
controles.kjv: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
controles.livre: E dirá: Onde estão seus deuses, A rocha em que se refugiavam;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵ֤לֶב זְבָחֵ֨ימוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔לוּ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ יֵ֣ין נְסִיכָ֑ם יָק֨וּמוּ֙ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶ֔ם יְהִ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם סִתְרָֽה׃

controles.web: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
controles.kjv: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
controles.livre: Que comiam a gordura de seus sacrifícios, Bebiam o veio de suas libações? Levante-se, que vos ajudem E vos defendam.

versos.hebraico: רְא֣וּ׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י אֲנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּדִ֑י אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַאֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֨צְתִּי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּֽיל׃

controles.web: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
controles.kjv: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
controles.livre: Vede agora que Eu, Eu Sou, e não há deus além de mim; eu trago a morte, e eu faço viver; eu firo, e eu curo; e não há quem possa escapar da minha mão.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶל־שָׁמַ֖יִם יָדִ֑י וְאָמַ֕רְתִּי חַ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י לְעֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
controles.kjv: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
controles.livre: Quando eu erguer aos céus minha mão, e disser: “Tão certo como eu vivo para sempre”,

versos.hebraico: אִם־שַׁנּוֹתִי֙ בְּרַ֣ק חַרְבִּ֔י וְתֹאחֵ֥ז בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט יָדִ֑י אָשִׁ֤יב נָקָם֙ לְצָרָ֔י וְלִמְשַׂנְאַ֖י אֲשַׁלֵּֽם׃

controles.web: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
controles.kjv: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
controles.livre: Se eu afiar minha espada reluzente, e minha mão agarrar o juízo, devolverei a vingança sobre os meus adversários, e retribuirei aos que me odeiam.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁכִּ֤יר חִצַּי֙ מִדָּ֔ם וְחַרְבִּ֖י תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר מִדַּ֤ם חָלָל֙ וְשִׁבְיָ֔ה מֵרֹ֖אשׁ פַּרְע֥וֹת אוֹיֵֽב׃

controles.web: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
controles.kjv: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
controles.livre: Embriagarei de sangue minhas flechas, e minha espada devorará carne, no sangue dos mortos e dos cativos, das cabeças dos líderes inimigos.

versos.hebraico: הַרְנִ֤ינוּ גוֹיִם֙ עַמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י דַם־עֲבָדָ֖יו יִקּ֑וֹם וְנָקָם֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לְצָרָ֔יו וְכִפֶּ֥ר אַדְמָת֖וֹ עַמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
controles.kjv: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
controles.livre: Jubilai, ó nações, com o povo dele, porque ele vingará o sangue dos seus servos, e devolverá a vingança sobre os seus inimigos, e expiará sua terra, pelo seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָֽה־הַזֹּ֖את בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃

controles.web: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.kjv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
controles.livre: E Moisés veio, e recitou todas as palavras deste cântico aos ouvidos do povo, ele, e Josué filho de Num.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
controles.kjv: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
controles.livre: E acabou Moisés de recitar todas estas palavras a todo Israel;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם לְכָל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵעִ֥יד בָּכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תְּצַוֻּם֙ אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

controles.web: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you this day, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Ponde vosso coração a todas as palavras que eu vos declaro hoje, para que as mandeis a vossos filhos, e cuidem de praticar todas as palavras desta lei.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־דָבָ֨ר רֵ֥ק הוּא֙ מִכֶּ֔ם כִּי־ה֖וּא חַיֵּיכֶ֑ם וּבַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ

controles.web: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
controles.kjv: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
controles.livre: Porque não vos é coisa vã, mas é vossa vida: e por elas fareis prolongar os dias sobre a terra, para possuir a qual passais o Jordão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּעֶ֛צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés aquele mesmo dia, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: עֲלֵ֡ה אֶל־הַר֩ הָעֲבָרִ֨ים הַזֶּ֜ה הַר־נְב֗וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃

controles.web: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
controles.kjv: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
controles.livre: Sobe a este monte de Abarim, ao monte Nebo, que está na terra de Moabe, que está em frente de Jericó, e olha a terra de Canaã, que eu dou por herança aos filhos de Israel;

versos.hebraico: וּמֻ֗ת בָּהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עֹלֶ֣ה שָׁ֔מָּה וְהֵאָסֵ֖ף אֶל־עַמֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־מֵ֞ת אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֨יךָ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃

controles.web: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
controles.kjv: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
controles.livre: E morre no monte ao qual sobes, e sê reunido a teus povos; ao modo que morreu Arão teu irmão no monte de Hor, e foi reunido a seus povos:

versos.hebraico: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְעַלְתֶּ֜ם בִּ֗י בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּמֵֽי־מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־צִ֑ן עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אוֹתִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: because you trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness in the midst of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Porquanto transgredistes contra mim em meio dos filhos de Israel nas águas da briga de Cades, no deserto de Zim; porque não me santificastes em meio dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י מִנֶּ֖גֶד תִּרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁ֨מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תָב֔וֹא אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
controles.kjv: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Verás, portanto, diante de ti a terra; mas não entrarás ali, à terra que dou aos filhos de Israel.
